entries.title: On iPad one press of Shift-Command-] moves one card
entries.body: In Infinitary on iPad with iPadOS 26 or later, one press of Shift-Command-] or Shift-Command-[ could skip a card while the next one was still opening. Each press now moves exactly one card, as on your Mac.
entries.noPicture: The fix is how many cards one key press moves, which a still picture cannot show.
